purpose: Map current model-visible skills into CodexFlow harness primitives without keeping the whole catalog in model context.

dispositions.kernel: Always-on or state-machine behavior below the model. No full skill prompt.
dispositions.event_flow: Deterministic trigger starts a workflow, interceptor, or gate. Only compact task facts reach the model.
dispositions.auto_profile: Task/project classifier activates a compact quality/domain policy. Full source skill is not loaded.
dispositions.tool_adapter: Capability is exposed as a tool/connector, not a skill description.
dispositions.specialist_module: Rare or style-specific knowledge remains lazy and is loaded only when explicitly/reliably triggered.
dispositions.project_playbook: Repository-specific operational knowledge remains project-local and lazy.
dispositions.command_view: Becomes a CLI/TUI command or report rather than model guidance.

capabilities.trigger: every model request when enabled
capabilities.behavior: Compression/token transport middleware with health checks, metrics, and bypass.

capabilities.trigger: code exploration and edit planning when semantic service is healthy
capabilities.behavior: Prefer symbols, definitions, references, and semantic navigation before raw repository scans.

capabilities.trigger: every code, config-semantic, test, build, or repository-structure change
capabilities.behavior: Prefer the smallest correct change; enforce deterministic budgets for new files, dependencies, crates, abstractions, and diff growth.

capabilities.trigger: explicit exhaustive/full/untruncated output request
capabilities.behavior: Prevent accidental truncation when exhaustive output is explicitly required.

capabilities.trigger: task classification
capabilities.behavior: Select the smallest useful lifecycle: answer, inspect, plan, implement, verify, review, deliver.

capabilities.trigger: before any engineering completion claim
capabilities.behavior: Require direct verification evidence appropriate to the task before completion.

capabilities.trigger: projects declaring engineering departments
capabilities.behavior: Generalize to CapabilityRouter; project manifests declare available departments and blocking rules.

capabilities.trigger: frontend/UI generation, redesign, or visual review
capabilities.behavior: Default anti-generic UI policy: hierarchy, typography, spacing, responsive behavior, accessibility, coherent tokens, intentional motion, and non-template composition.

capabilities.trigger: UI task includes motion, animation, transition, or choreography
capabilities.behavior: Motion quality, easing, reduced-motion behavior, and choreography defaults.

capabilities.trigger: animation added/changed or animation-performance request
capabilities.behavior: Profile jank, leaks, CPU/GPU pressure, and animation regressions before completion.

capabilities.trigger: user-facing prose generation or rewrite unless exact/legal/verbatim mode
capabilities.behavior: Remove generic AI cadence and filler while preserving requested voice, meaning, register, and technical precision.

capabilities.trigger: brand/marketing/identity task or project brand manifest present
capabilities.behavior: Apply project brand voice, visual identity, messaging, and asset consistency.

capabilities.trigger: project uses shadcn/Radix/Tailwind or user requests them
capabilities.behavior: Use accessible native project components and variants before inventing replacements.

capabilities.trigger: React/Next project or touched files
capabilities.behavior: Performance-aware data fetching, component boundaries, rendering, and bundle discipline.

capabilities.trigger: React Native/Expo project or touched files
capabilities.behavior: Mobile-native performance, animation, module, and rendering practices.

capabilities.trigger: user supplies a screenshot/reference image and asks for implementation
capabilities.behavior: Reference analysis -> fidelity plan -> implementation -> visual verification.

capabilities.trigger: existing site/app redesign request
capabilities.behavior: Audit first, preserve functionality, apply frontend quality profile, verify regressions.

capabilities.trigger: explicit artifact/style/platform/3D intent
capabilities.behavior: Keep style-specific or rare creative knowledge out of baseline context; load only the selected module.

capabilities.trigger: project declares low_latency and task touches data plane, networking, protocol, serialization, or performance
capabilities.behavior: Measurement-first low-latency defaults, explicit backpressure, allocation/message-size discipline, and protocol correctness.

capabilities.trigger: specific WAN/VPS, kernel-bypass, Linux NIC fastpath, or time-sync task
capabilities.behavior: Rare expert knowledge loads only into the relevant specialist context.

capabilities.trigger: performance/latency/binary-size claim or optimization
capabilities.behavior: Require before/after measurement, tail metrics where relevant, and evidence that the optimization addresses the measured bottleneck.

capabilities.trigger: matching user intent
capabilities.behavior: Expose direct capabilities through the tool router rather than skill catalog entries.

capabilities.trigger: matching connected-resource intent
capabilities.behavior: Route to connected Google tools without adding skill descriptions to the model prompt.

capabilities.trigger: matching artifact or active Office-session intent
capabilities.behavior: Route directly to artifact/Office engines.

capabilities.trigger: create/update skill or plugin request
capabilities.behavior: Author extension in quarantine/worktree, validate schema/tests, then pass through install-security gate before activation.

capabilities.trigger: before any skill, plugin, MCP, or harness-extension activation
capabilities.behavior: Quarantine source -> provenance/permission inspection -> SkillSpector static scan -> policy-selected semantic scan -> structured report -> blocking TUI decision -> transactional install.

capabilities.trigger: explicit Sites build/publish task
capabilities.behavior: Keep external app-specific operating knowledge lazy.

capabilities.trigger: diff review or repository complexity audit
capabilities.behavior: Review over-engineering and removable complexity as a native review/caretaker pass.

capabilities.trigger: explicit CLI/TUI command
capabilities.behavior: Render debt, impact, and help directly without a model skill.

capabilities.trigger: Rust project/file touch; async/concurrency fragments activate only when matching symbols/tasks are present
capabilities.behavior: Idiomatic ownership/error/invariant rules with conditional async and determinism overlays.

capabilities.trigger: unsafe, FFI, memory-map, byte decoding, alignment, or endianness change
capabilities.behavior: Require boundary invariants, safety reasoning, and focused verification.

capabilities.trigger: Rust bugfix, new invariant, unsafe/concurrency/parser change
capabilities.behavior: Select the smallest relevant combination of tests, property checks, fuzzing, Miri, Loom, mutation, or differential verification.

capabilities.trigger: dependency/source/license/action change
capabilities.behavior: Dependency provenance, advisory, license, and source checks before acceptance.

capabilities.trigger: public API, MSRV, toolchain, or feature-matrix change
capabilities.behavior: Protect supported compiler/API/feature contracts.

capabilities.trigger: project manifest marks touched paths as financially consequential
capabilities.behavior: Independent blocking review for execution/OMS/gateway/reconciliation/readiness/halt invariants.

capabilities.trigger: explicit maintenance request or scheduled caretaker scan
capabilities.behavior: Discover bounded maintenance, prune dead surfaces with evidence, and stop at configured delivery authority.

capabilities.trigger: framing/protobuf/FIX/binary parser change
capabilities.behavior: Bounds, malformed-input behavior, fuzzing, conformance vectors, and parser differential checks.

capabilities.trigger: release/tag/package/publish event
capabilities.behavior: Source identity, checksums, dependency inventory, SBOM/attestation policy, and release evidence.

capabilities.trigger: non-trivial implementation reaches verified state or explicit review
capabilities.behavior: Fresh-context independent review with deterministic checks for change size, tests, breaking behavior, context, correctness, and unnecessary complexity.

capabilities.trigger: tracing, metrics, diagnostics, SLO, alert, or production-evidence work
capabilities.behavior: Evidence-oriented observability, secret-safe logs, actionable metrics, and SLO-aware alerting.

capabilities.trigger: new authority/file/folder/crate/dependency edge or suspicious duplication/complexity
capabilities.behavior: Discover existing authority first; reject accidental duplicate responsibility and unjustified repository growth.

capabilities.trigger: first implementation verification becomes green
capabilities.behavior: Run one bounded simplification pass before review.

capabilities.trigger: explicit broad simplification/cleanup campaign
capabilities.behavior: Characterize behavior and simplify incrementally rather than applying automatic code golf.

capabilities.trigger: every build/test/tooling decision
capabilities.behavior: Prefer check/focused tests/incremental caches; preserve target caches; escalate to full/release builds only when required.

capabilities.trigger: typed-language internal API/boundary work
capabilities.behavior: Keep dynamic JSON/stringly contracts at external boundaries rather than spreading them into the typed core.

capabilities.trigger: material ambiguity or multi-step/non-trivial task
capabilities.behavior: Skip ceremony for clear small work; otherwise resolve material ambiguity, create an executable plan, then track execution.

capabilities.trigger: new behavior/bugfix where an executable test can express the requirement
capabilities.behavior: Use red/green/cleanup when it adds signal; do not force TDD for tasks where it is artificial.

capabilities.trigger: first meaningful test/tool/runtime failure or repeated unsuccessful edit
capabilities.behavior: Stop blind retries, identify root cause and evidence, then change the smallest causal surface.

capabilities.trigger: verified implementation or incoming review findings
capabilities.behavior: Prepare concise review evidence; evaluate feedback against repository facts before editing.

capabilities.trigger: task decomposition yields bounded independent work
capabilities.behavior: Choose single worker, sequential specialists, or parallel disjoint workers without loading orchestration playbooks into every agent.

capabilities.trigger: parallel isolation, branch finalization, PR creation, or PR update
capabilities.behavior: Worktree/branch lifecycle, evidence-aware PR body, CI/watch loop, and merge-readiness gate.

capabilities.trigger: production reliability, capacity, readiness, recovery, or SLO-impacting change
capabilities.behavior: Independent SRE gate when activated.

capabilities.trigger: new trust boundary, credentials/permissions, external attack surface, dependency risk, or scheduled security scan
capabilities.behavior: Threat, identity/secrets, and application-security gates selected independently by task facts.

capabilities.trigger: cloud/VPS/IaC/host/systemd/firewall/certificate/kernel/NIC/deployment task
capabilities.behavior: Deployment planning and rollback-aware execution; infrastructure work never wakes for ordinary code tasks.

capabilities.trigger: incident/outage/data-loss anomaly or explicit controlled chaos experiment
capabilities.behavior: Incident mode can preempt normal feature automation; chaos remains explicit and bounded.

capabilities.trigger: cross-cutting ownership/protocol/deployment boundary change
capabilities.behavior: Architecture gate with ADR/authority implications when material.

capabilities.trigger: dataset/schema/timestamp/provenance/reproducibility change
capabilities.behavior: Data integrity and evidence-lineage gates.

capabilities.trigger: quant/research experiment, strategy claim, or production-promotion decision
capabilities.behavior: Research validity and promotion evidence remain independent blocking gates.

capabilities.trigger: CI/cache/reproducible-build/package/release task
capabilities.behavior: Cloud/local build policy, caching, artifact identity, qualification, and rollback-ready packaging.

capabilities.trigger: only while working on the Codex source project and matching task
capabilities.behavior: Keep repository-specific maintenance knowledge out of generic CodexFlow behavior.
